title: imap::Config::validate does not check auth.users passwords are bcrypt
description: reader::Config::validate() calls looks_like_bcrypt_hash on each auth.users entry and returns ConfigError::Validation on plaintext. imap::Config::validate() has no equivalent check. In production, a plaintext password in imap auth.users passes validate() and Config::from_file successfully, then panics in stoa_auth::CredentialStore::from_credentials when main() calls it. The imap VALID_TOML test constant uses password = "hunter2" (plaintext) and the test passes — demonstrating that validate() accepts it. Fix: add the same looks_like_bcrypt_hash loop to imap::Config::validate() that reader has, returning ConfigError::Validation. Also fix the VALID_TOML test constant to use a real bcrypt hash.
